vo.text: Read the pins, move the moisture bands, switch to variance, and filter what the map shows.
vo.next_text: Each sprinkler of a station scanned in the past seven days is a pin at its own coordinates. A pin scanned today is filled with the colour of the moisture band its reading falls into, and a pin last scanned on an earlier day is drawn clear.

vo.text: Each sprinkler of a station scanned in the past seven days is a pin at its own coordinates. A pin scanned today is filled with the colour of the moisture band its reading falls into, and a pin last scanned on an earlier day is drawn clear.
vo.previous_text: Read the pins, move the moisture bands, switch to variance, and filter what the map shows.
vo.next_text: Four bands by default: 0 to 5, 6 to 19, 20 to 30, and above 30 percent.

vo.text: Four bands by default: 0 to 5, 6 to 19, 20 to 30, and above 30 percent.
vo.previous_text: Each sprinkler of a station scanned in the past seven days is a pin at its own coordinates. A pin scanned today is filled with the colour of the moisture band its reading falls into, and a pin last scanned on an earlier day is drawn clear.
vo.next_text: The colour bar under the legend has draggable handles. Move one and the map recolours when you let go.

vo.text: The colour bar under the legend has draggable handles. Move one and the map recolours when you let go.
vo.previous_text: Four bands by default: 0 to 5, 6 to 19, 20 to 30, and above 30 percent.
vo.next_text: Dragging a handle changes the boundary and saves it to your preferences.

vo.previous_text: The colour bar under the legend has draggable handles. Move one and the map recolours when you let go.
vo.next_text: The button beside the legend toggles between VWC and variance.

vo.previous_text: Dragging a handle changes the boundary and saves it to your preferences.
vo.next_text: Variance colours each pin by how far it sits from its own target instead of by its raw reading: three bands, centred on target.

vo.previous_text: The button beside the legend toggles between VWC and variance.
vo.next_text: Layers chooses which stations are drawn: all of them, or only the enabled ones.

vo.next_text: Disabled stations are not being adjusted, so hiding them leaves only the heads your push will affect. Layers saves your choice to your user preferences.
